text:
Jimmy Snuggerud has 10 goals in 19 games in his second NHL season, and he's earned the chances. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him in the 96th percentile among forwards for scoring chances from the slot last season, with an unusual signature: 29% of his setups come from behind the net, against 8% for a typical forward. He goes where goals are scored.

The rate is the part to treat with care. Ten goals on 5.1 expected (the quality of his chances) means he's shooting 24%, double last season's 12%, and the Blues have scored 5.2 more goals than their chances deserved with him on the ice. Both of those tend to come back down. Our talent range has him finishing closer to 14% over time, which still makes him a useful scorer on 18 minutes a night.

He's 22, the 23rd pick in 2022, and already ahead of most forwards drafted around him. What to watch: whether his chances per game stay where they are once the shooting cools. Evolving-Hockey's flag from last season, chances against piling up with him on, is the other thing.
headline: Snuggerud's finishing is running hot
